LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Commander.label: Commander
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Commander.description: A command mech for the legion's information chain. Provides bandwidth offloading and assists the mechanitor in controlling mechanoids. Can lead caravans.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Shaman.label: Shaman
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Shaman.description: A mechanoid equipped with a soul-calling device that provides group stealth.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Scout.label: Scout
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Scout.description: A vanguard equipped with mechanical horse legs. Artificial muscles provide unmatched speed, making it indispensable for reconnaissance.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Guardian.label: Guardian
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Guardian.description: A heavily armored mech with integrated fire control for high-intensity combat zones.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Arsonist.label: Arsonist
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Arsonist.description: A heavily armored mech developed for high-intensity combat. Fitted with integrated fire control for long-range accuracy comparable to musketeers.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_SupportFrame.label: Support Frame
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_SupportFrame.description: An improved variant of the combat frame for testing heavy weapons on walkers.
LanguageData.DMSL_Drone_CommandingBird.label: Commanding Bird
LanguageData.DMSL_Drone_CommandingBird.description: A mini command drone deployed from the belt to help the mechanitor direct combat from behind the lines.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Terra.label: Terra
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Terra.description: A mechanoid once used for raid missions. Special bionic adapters allow it to freely equip human gear.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Engineer.label: Engineer
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Engineer.description: An engineering mech with mechanoid restart equipment. Repairs damaged mechanoids or reboots shut-down ones.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Commandos.label: Commandos
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_Commandos.description: A heavily armored mech developed for high-intensity combat. Fitted with integrated fire control for long-range accuracy comparable to musketeers.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_SpecialPolice.label: Special Police
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_SpecialPolice.description: A riot control mech equipped with stun devices and jet shoulders.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_DesignatedMarksman.label: Designated Marksman
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_DesignatedMarksman.description: Full snipers proved too expensive for squad-level marksmanship. The designated marksman filled that role.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_ArmoredGrenadiers.label: Armored Grenadiers
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_ArmoredGrenadiers.description: A mech for anti-tank and grenade-throwing duties in high-intensity combat zones.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_DoctorFrame.label: Doctor Frame
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_DoctorFrame.description: An improved variant of the combat frame that can perform doctoring and cooking. You wouldn't use it for anything but saving lives, would you?
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_AgriculturalFrame.label: Agricultural Frame
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_AgriculturalFrame.description: An improved variant of the combat frame for farming tasks. Often a symbol of peace and love in literature. Drops 2-3 extra hay when harvesting.
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_DrillingBarge.label: Drilling Barge
LanguageData.DMSL_Mech_DrillingBarge.description: An improved variant of the combat frame, primarily for mining—it can also operate deep drills to extract underground deposits.
